TEXT:

the Destiny Record.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] Okayokayokay~! That's enough beating around the 
bush~♪

TEXT: [FI] Now, let's start from the top.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] Thank you for buying "Ore no Imouto ga Konna ni 
Kawaii Wake ga Nai Portable ga Tsuzuku Wake ga 
Nai"!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] How do you do? I'm the one that governs your 
destiny, the super adorable fairy Kiririn~

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] And this is Kuronyan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT: [FI] Nice to meet you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] Hm? Do we resemble someone?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:

about such minor details♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] I mean, where else could you find girls this cute?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] How unabashed of you. Alright, let's get to the real 
issue at hand.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] OK, um~ We will now give a brief explanation of 
the game and decide on your destined scenario to 
play.

TEXT:
[FI] This game is a sequel to the previous title, "Ore no 
Imouto ga Konna ni Kawaii Wake ga Nai Portable", 
but...

TEXT:

from where I'm standing.

continuing after the previous game's endings, while

TEXT:
[FI] You're making it harder to understand with that 
kind of explanation.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] Other than a few exceptions, this game starts at 
the point of you starting a relationship with your 
lover- or someone you care for.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] Being with your beloved girlfriend... Spending a fun 
summertime together - that's basically the idea of 
this game.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT: [FI] Do you understand now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] We will now start asking questions about "Your 
Cute Lover", so do answer this seriously!

correct choices.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] Order Record Effect (O.R.E System), the key items 
to answer our questions.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT: [FI] ...Do you know how to use these?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] Yes yes, just like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT: [FI] ...What a helpless being. I'll explain it then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] ...Do you see the O.R.Es displayed on the top corners 
of the screen right now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] Select them by pressing Left or Right on the D-Pad, 
then press the Square button to confirm your 
choice.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT: [FI] Do you understand?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] By the way, not selecting anything in this example is 
the same as selecting No.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] Yes yes, just like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] ...You really are helpless. I'll explain it again, once

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:

TEXT:

TEXT:

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT: [FI] Thank you for properly playing it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] Well then, that's the gist of it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] Wow-!? It's fully completed!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT: [FI] ...Oh my. Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT: [FI] ...Amazing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:

TEXT: [FI] Um... I'll say this only once, so listen carefully.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] Thanks, Aniki.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT: [FI] Please try to fully complete this game too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] Well then, that's the gist of it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, you! Why are you playing the sequel without 
playing the previous game!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] It's bundled in the same package with this game, 
so get to it quickly!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] Well, suddenly playing this isn't really a problem 
though...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] Ending up in this situation isn't an oversight. That's 
why we are here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] He hasn't played the previous game, so we'll guide 
him to the routes that contain little connections to 
the past.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] That's true. Well then, that's the gist of it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] This time I'll give you these 3 O.R.Es.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] Right, good luck!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:

forward to what kind of tale you will spin...

TEXT: [FI] Have a safe journey♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] Isn't it an appropriate location for the next 
question?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] Alright, onto the next question.

TEXT: [FI] Do you have a girlfriend?

TEXT:

TEXT:
